newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina leaves for Rome Wednesday night to attend the World Food Summit.
A oil well has been drilled in the Kailashtila gas field in the easten district of Sylhet to produce 550 barrels of crude per day.
Armed pirates hijacked a motor launch carrying about 100 passengers on Tuesday in a river along the coastal district of Patuakhali and took it to an unknown destination.
The planned peace talks between the government and the tribal insurgents are likely to be held on November 23.
Deposed president H M Ershad said on Tuesday that his Jatiya Party would achieve majority in the next general elections.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has asked the Planning Commission to prepare a five-year development plan aiming to raise the GDP growth rate to at least seven percent.
The government is working on opening a second chanel of the state-run Bangladesh Television.
